```{r}
library('ggplot2')
library('reshape2')
library("scales")
library('tidyquant')
```

```{r}
cichlid_colours = c('#C3BE46FF', '#4D4D4DFF',  '#00CCFF') # calliptera, Ramphos, zebras

```

```{r}
import <- function(fname, channel) {
  data <- read.csv(fname)
  
  # select only the channel of interest
  data <- data[c(1, channel + 3)]
  
  #rescale both channels
  data[[1]] <- rescale(data[[1]])
  data[[2]] <- rescale(data[[2]])
  
  #convert column names for easy plotting 
  colnames(data) <- c('AP_position', 'Expression')
  
  return(data)
}

```



```{r}
metadata <- read.csv('data/metadata.csv')
# remove lines we don't want 
metadata <- metadata[,0:7]
metadata <- metadata[!metadata$skip,]
metadata$stage = NULL
metadata <- na.omit(metadata)


data <- data.frame()

ndim = dim(metadata)[1]

for (i in c(1:ndim)){
  # extract all metadata from the file 
  fname <- paste('data/', metadata$filename[i], sep='')
  channel <- metadata[i, 2]
  genename <- metadata[i, 3]
  embryo_name <- metadata[i, 4]
  species <- metadata[i, 5]
  stage <- metadata[i, 6]

  # import the data and add metadata
  dat <- import(fname, channel)
  dat$species <- species 
  dat$gene_name <- genename 
  dat$name <- embryo_name
  dat$stage <- stage
  

  data <- rbind(data, dat)

    
}

data$species[data$species == "R. chillingali"] <- "R. chilingali"

```



```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = AP_position, 
                 y = Expression, 
                 color = species, 
                 group = name)) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2) + 
  geom_ma(ma_fun = SMA, n = 10, 
    linetype = 'solid', linewidth = 1) + 
  facet_wrap('gene_name', ncol = 5) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = cichlid_colours) + 
  xlab('Position (AP)') + 
  ylab('Expression (AU)') + 
  theme(legend.position="right")


ggsave('../../graphs/Fig5I.png', dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 2.2)
```
